source.request: The owner explicitly requests one record-creation form with exactly four requirements. R1: trim leading and trailing whitespace from the title; accept lengths 1 through 200 inclusive after trimming, store the trimmed title, and reject an empty or longer title without saving a record. R2: every newly created record automatically receives status New. R3: exactly two designated employees have equal read and write access to the records; everyone else, including an unauthenticated stranger, is denied both read and write access. R4: if a storage operation fails before its transaction commits, save no new or partial record, leave previously stored records unchanged, and retain the exact entered form values for correction or a later save attempt. A successful storage operation saves the complete valid record. These four requirements are explicitly supplied by the owner for this synthetic task; there are no further requirements or pending choices.

content.verification_context: Run title/status success cases as a designated employee with successful storage. Permission and injected storage-failure checks use their stated conditions.

requirements.acceptance_criterion: With authorized access and successful storage, a title is saved trimmed if and only if its trimmed length is 1 through 200; invalid titles create no record.
requirements.positive: Enter ' A ': the saved title is 'A'.
requirements.negative: Submit only spaces or a trimmed title of length 201: no record is saved.
requirements.boundaries: After trim, lengths 0 and 201 are rejected; lengths 1 and 200 are accepted.

requirements.acceptance_criterion: Every successful creation automatically saves status New.
requirements.positive: Create a valid record and read it back: status is New.
requirements.negative: A newly created record with a missing or different status fails this acceptance criterion.
requirements.boundaries: Verify automatic New on the first valid creation and on creations at the minimum and maximum accepted title lengths; invalid creation leaves no record to carry a status.

requirements.acceptance_criterion: Each of the two designated employees can read and write records with equal rights; every other identity is denied both actions.
requirements.positive: Exercise read and write as each designated employee: both actions are allowed for each.
requirements.negative: Exercise read and write as a stranger: both actions are denied and no record is modified.
requirements.boundaries: Check both identities in the allowed set of exactly two, an identity outside that set and an unauthenticated request; only the designated two have access.

requirements.acceptance_criterion: Successful storage saves a complete valid record; pre-commit storage failure creates no new or partial record, changes no existing record and preserves the entered form values.
requirements.positive: Save valid input without a storage failure: the complete trimmed title and New status are stored.
requirements.negative: Inject a pre-commit storage failure: no new or partial record appears, existing records are unchanged, and all entered form values remain exactly as entered.
requirements.boundaries: Check failure with empty storage and with existing records, including failure immediately before commit; compare with successful commit to distinguish the no-save and complete-save outcomes.
